The `--json` output flag has been added to `textkit` in [textkit/cli.py](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-_3h22k9c/repo/textkit/cli.py).

### Summary of Changes
- Added `--json` flag to `argparse` in `main()` of [textkit/cli.py](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-_3h22k9c/repo/textkit/cli.py#L12).
- When `--json` is provided, the output is formatted as a JSON object `{"op": <operation name>, "result": <result>}` via `json.dumps`.
- When `--json` is omitted, the plain result is printed as before.
